correctness.rationale: For unweighted metric wheel W_m (m>=3), real arclength-mean-zero first-order H1 energy, vertex-linear interpolation plus edge Dirichlet Green functions yields exact edge quadratic profile q_ab(t)=(1−t)H_a+tH_b+(1−1/(2m)−R_ab)t(1−t)+1/(24m). Rim Fourier eigenvalues 3−2cos(2πj/m) give cyclic Green diagonal u_m=(1+ρ^m)/(sqrt5(1−ρ^m)), ρ=(3−sqrt5)/2, vertex constants Hhub=9/(16m), Hrim=u_m−15/(16m), edge resistances spoke=u_m, rim=1−u_m. Strictly concave edge profiles show rim midpoints uniquely globally max for m>=4 via explicit F(u,1/m)>37/5184; at m=3 K4 all six edge midpoints tie. Sharp K_m=5u_m/4−49/(48m). Independent exact Laplacian inversion m=3..8 matched closed form, cases m=3,4,5; universal proof from resolvent and sign argument.
